content.title: Where to watch iHeartRadio Music Awards 2026: TV channel and streaming
content.text: The iHeartRadio Music Awards 2026 are set to celebrate the biggest radio hits that defined 2025, bringing together some of the most influential names in music for one night in Los Angeles.To watch this video, agree to share video information with third partiesAgree|More infoHeld at the iconic Dolby Theatre, this year's ceremony promises major performances, high-profile awards, and a star-studded lineup.What time do the iHeartRadio Music Awards start?The show kicks off on Thursday, March 26, airing from 8 p.m. to 10 p.m. ET/PT on Fox Broadcasting Company.It will air live on the East Coast, while West Coast viewers will see a tape-delayed broadcast.Where to watch on TV and streamingIn addition to its TV broadcast on Fox, the awards will be widely accessible streaming platforms and radio:Live across iHeartRadio stations nationwideStreaming on the iHeartRadio appAvailable via subscription services such as FuboTV, Hulu + Live TV, Sling TV, DirecTV Stream and YouTube TVThis wide availability makes it easy for viewers to tune in whether they prefer traditional TV or streaming.Who's hosting?Rapper and actor Ludacris will host the ceremony. He is also set to receive the prestigious Landmark Award, recognizing artists whose work has shaped culture over time.Special honors and major nomineesSeveral major artists will be recognized during the night:Miley Cyrus will receive the Innovator AwardJohn Mellencamp will be honored with the Icon AwardAs for nominations, the lineup includes top names like Bad Bunny, Kendrick Lamar, Taylor Swift, Sabrina Carpenter and Cardi B.Swift leads all nominees with nine nominations and already holds the record as the most-awarded artist in the show's history, with 34 wins.Who's performing?The ceremony will also feature performances from a mix of legendary and rising artists, including John Mellencamp, TLC, Kehlani, Alex Warren and Lainey Wilson.
